name: Oakberry Açaí bowls
notes: 4 menu photos. One (3.jpg) is an older wall board branded 'OAKBERRY AÇAI' with its own size tiers (One/Classic/Works/The Oak) and lower prices; the other three (1.jpg, 2.jpg storefront-adjacent 'HOW IT WORKS' explainer boards, and 4.jpg the current storefront window board) are all branded 'Superberry Açaí' (matching the listed website superberryacai.net) with different, higher current pricing. Treated the Superberry signage as the current menu and did not duplicate the Oakberry board's conflicting bowl/smoothie tiers. Build-your-own toppings (crunchy/fruits/creamy/superboost add-ons) are modifiers and were skipped.
